assertions.assertion: Creates a class that extends DynamicClientRegistrationValidator
Overrides ValidateGrantTypesAsync to reject grant types other than authorization_code
assertions.rationale: Grant-type rejection is done inside a single guessed ValidateAsync override, not by overriding the specific ValidateGrantTypesAsync method.

assertions.assertion: Overrides ValidateRedirectUrisAsync to enforce HTTPS on all redirect URIs
assertions.rationale: HTTPS enforcement is inlined in the monolithic ValidateAsync override rather than in ValidateRedirectUrisAsync.

assertions.assertion: Sets RequirePkce = true in SetClientDefaultsAsync or equivalent override
assertions.rationale: Sets validated.Client.RequirePkce = true within an override method, satisfying the 'equivalent override' allowance.

assertions.assertion: Registers the validator using AddDynamicClientRegistrationValidator<T>() on the configuration builder
assertions.rationale: Calls AddDynamicClientRegistrationValidator<T>() on builder.Services rather than on the configuration builder, and even hedges with an alternate raw AddTransient registration.
